blocks.text: NEW YORK — Stocking up on discounted shampoo while grabbing a flat-screen TV and several Lego sets for under the tree. Making a holiday list, comparing style options and delivery dates, and finding the best price with help from artificial intelligence. Black Friday, the retail industry’s version of the Super Bowl, comes with a few twists this year. Brands and stores have promoted steep discounts online and in stores all month, making the day once considered the holiday shopping season’s unofficial kickoff seem more like the fourth quarter of a football game.
